events.name: The Clockwork Vault
events.intro: A hall of gears under a stone dome. Three levers must be pulled for the middle door to open. The floor is full of traps. A brass plate: "MADE FOR SOMEONE WHO WILL KNOW WHAT IT IS FOR."

success.text: The gears turn as you step inside, slowly, like something breathing in its sleep.
You leave the gears to their ticking.

events.name: The Hall of Gears
events.intro: Three passages, and a round door in the middle with three empty slots.

success.text: You take the left passage. The air smells of hot metal.
You take the right passage. The floor drops away ahead.
You take the centre passage. It's very cold.
Three levers down. The gears in the round door start to turn, one inside another, and it rolls open.

events.name: The Cold Lever
events.intro: Two levers. One is right. One drops a blade. A plate: "The cold lever is the true one."

success.text: The left one is warm. The right one is cold as a stone in a river. You pull the right. Somewhere, a gear drops into place.
A blade drops from the ceiling. Your Pokémon pulls you back, and takes the cut instead. Then you pull the right one.
It's cold under your hand. A gear drops into place. Safe.

events.name: The Pit
events.intro: A spiked pit, a lever on the far side, a narrow beam.

success.text: One foot, the other foot. You don't look down. You pull the lever on the far side.

failure.text: Halfway across, you wobble. Your lead catches you, and catches a spike for it. You make it, and pull the lever.

success.text: Your Flying-type carries you over and sets you down by the lever. Easy.
Your Psychic-type closes its eyes. The lever pulls itself.

events.name: The Sparks
events.intro: Live wires across the floor. A lever in a cage of arcs.

success.text: Your Ground-type puts one foot on the wires. The arcs die. You walk in and pull the lever.
Your Electric-type drinks the sparks down, delighted, glowing. You pull the lever.
You reach through. It hurts. You pull the lever anyway. Your lead takes the jolt with you, and its legs are still twitching.

events.name: The Gear Door
events.intro: Inside: a ticking heart-shaped box on a cushion, and a note in old handwriting: "When she is ready."

success.text: It's empty. But it's warm, as if something was just here. As if something will be.
You leave it ticking on its cushion. The vault closes behind you.
You turn the little key. It ticks faster, happier. Somewhere, something hears it.

events.name: The Trapped Crypt
events.intro: Stone stairs down to a crypt of three trapped chambers. Whoever built it didn't want visitors, and left a lot of gold. A carving: THE FIRST GYM'S LEADERS REST HERE.

success.text: The stairs are worn in the middle by a lot of feet, a long time ago.
You bow your head at the top of the stairs. On the top step, someone has left a Cleanse Tag. It's for you, you think.
There isn't one. There's only down.

events.name: The Darts
events.intro: Walls pocked with holes. A pressure plate every few steps.

success.text: Slowly. Very slowly. Nothing fires.
The darts bounce off your Steel-type like rain off a roof.
You run. Something stings. One of your Pokémon is poisoned.

events.name: The Pit
events.intro: The floor ends in a spiked pit. A thin ledge runs round the wall.

success.text: Back to the wall, inch by inch. You make it.

choices.label: Bridge it with a Grass- or Ice-type.

success.text: Vines, or ice, laid straight across. You walk over it like a road.
You jump. You make it, mostly. Your lead takes the landing.

events.name: The Last Guardian
events.intro: A stone door, and the crypt's last guardian: an old woman in a faded Gym uniform, three ancient Pokémon at her feet. Guardian, Aeda: "I kept the door when the Gym fell. I've kept it since. They're sleeping. All the first Leaders." Aeda: "The gold's for whoever proves they aren't here for gold."

success.text: Aeda: "Prove it." She holds out a bag of old gold. It is very heavy.
Aeda: "Then wake up, old friends." Fire, Water, Grass: ancient, slow, and very strong.
She names them, one by one, slowly, like she is waking them. Then she waits.

remembers.notice: Your three old badges glint. The stone door opens by itself. Aeda puts her hands over her face and weeps. She is the last keeper. You know her name already.

success.text: You sit with her until she can talk. Then she gives you the First Badge, and goes in to sleep beside them.

events.name: The Last Guardian
events.intro: Aeda finishes the last name and folds her hands.

success.text: Aeda: "Prove it." She holds out the gold.
Aeda: "Then wake up, old friends."

events.name: The Gold
events.intro: The bag of gold sits in Aeda's old hands.

success.text: You close her fingers back around it. Aeda looks at you for a long time. Then she takes a small badge from her own collar: the First Badge. Aeda: "Then you're the one." She sits down by the door, and closes her eyes, and finally rests.
You take it. Aeda nods. She is not surprised. She is a little sad.

events.name: The Stuck Gate
events.intro: A short-handed Ranger outpost. Ranger Basil: "Gate's stuck and the herd's on the wrong side. Hand?"

success.text: You set your shoulder to it with Basil. It gives. The herd pours through, and Basil laughs out loud.
Your Pokémon leans on the gate and it swings wide. The herd crosses. Basil writes your name in the outpost book.
Basil waves you on. "Another time."

events.name: One of Ours, Nearly
events.intro: Basil, at the outpost gate, with something wrapped in a Ranger's scarf. Basil: "One of ours, nearly. Take this."

success.text: A Ranger's whistle. Basil: "Blow it once. If one of yours goes down in a fight you lose, we'll carry them out, and they'll be on their feet."
Basil shakes his head, smiling, and hangs it back on your neck anyway. "The outpost says keep it."
Basil: "A rescue. One. Any of yours, any fight you lose. We'll get them out." He presses it into your hand.

events.name: Spare Eyes
events.intro: Scholars cataloguing local Pokémon. Scholar Ines-Marie: "We need a spare pair of eyes. Count the Wurmple, would you?"

success.text: Forty-one. You count twice. Ines-Marie checks. Forty-one. She looks at you with new respect.
"About thirty?" Ines-Marie looks at you over her glasses. She noticed.
Ines-Marie goes back to counting, lips moving.

events.name: One of Ours, Nearly
events.intro: Ines-Marie, with a thick folder under her arm. Ines-Marie: "One of ours, nearly. Take this."

success.text: Field notes on every wild Pokémon in {nextRegion}: what they know, what they can do. Pages and pages of it.

events.name: Look the Other Way
events.intro: A shady crew in an alley. Crew boss, Lark: "Need someone to look the other way for a minute."

success.text: You study a very interesting brick. Something heavy is carried past behind you. Lark: "Appreciated."
Lark: "A crate. Not Pokémon. I promise." He means it.
Lark shrugs. "Your call." The crew finds someone else.

events.name: Look the Other Way
events.intro: Lark waits. The crate waits.

success.text: You look away. Lark: "Appreciated."
Lark shrugs. "Your call."

events.name: One of Ours, Nearly
events.intro: Lark, leaning on a wall like he owns it. Lark: "Take this. And one day I'll ask a favour back."

success.text: A coin with a hole in it. Lark: "Show that to any team's guards, once. They've been paid." He smiles. "And one day, I'll ask."
Lark laughs, a real laugh. "Nobody gets no strings." He pockets the coin again.
Lark: "You'll know." He holds the coin out, and waits.

events.name: One of Ours, Nearly
events.intro: The coin with the hole in it.

success.text: Lark: "Good." The coin goes in your pocket.
Lark laughs. "Nobody gets no strings."

events.name: The Price
events.intro: A region later, Lark falls into step beside you. He has a sealed package under his arm. Lark: "That favour. Carry this past the Ranger checkpoint. Don't open it."

success.text: The Rangers search it. Inside: letters. Lark's love letters, years of them, to someone across the border. Completely legal. Deeply embarrassing. The Rangers look at you differently after that.
Lark looks at you for a long moment. He isn't angry. He's hurt, which is worse. "Right," he says. "Right."

events.name: No Charge

remembers.notice: You remember a letter in your own handwriting: "Don't trust the guide with the free shortcut."

success.text: He tips his hat. Mosley: "Somebody warned you. Smart somebody." He walks off whistling, and doesn't look back.

events.intro: A weathered guide offers you a shortcut. Guide, Mosley: "No charge. I just like company." If you look closely: his boots are new. He checks your bag twice. His "shortcut" adds distance on the map.

success.text: The shortcut is real, more or less. He chats the whole way. You notice him writing something in a little book.
Mosley looks down at them. "...Gift." He leaves quickly, and doesn't look back.
Mosley shrugs and waits for the next traveller.

events.name: The Crossing
events.intro: Mosley at the crossing, too relaxed. Two strangers behind him. Mosley: "Hand over your coins."

success.text: Mosley sighs. "Have it your way."

choices.label: I told the Rangers you'd be here.

success.text: The trees move. Rangers step out on every side. Mosley closes his eyes. "Of course you did." No battle. He goes quietly.
You hand over half of what you have. Mosley counts it twice. Word gets around.

events.name: A Quiet Hello
events.intro: A wild Pokémon watches your team from a distance. Not afraid, not angry. Waiting.

success.text: You sit. It watches. Then it comes a little closer, and a little closer, and stops just out of reach. Then it leaves.
You hold out a hand. It comes closer, sniffs the air, and goes.
You walk on.

remembers.notice: It looks at you like it already knows you.

success.text: You sit. It walks straight to you and sits too. When you stand, it comes with you. No battle. It just decided.
It presses its head into your hand, and then follows you. It has decided.

remembers.notice: It looks at you, and its fur rises.

success.text: It backs away, then turns and runs, crying out. All along the road, wild Pokémon go quiet. They've been warned.

events.name: It Doesn't Want to Fight
events.intro: A wild Pokémon trembles in the grass. Frightened, or guarding something.

success.text: You back away slowly. It stops trembling.
Behind it, in a hollow: eggs. It watches you look, and lets you. Then it settles back over them.
It fights like it has no choice. It doesn't.

remembers.notice: It knows you. You can see it decide.

success.text: You back away. It stops trembling. Later, on the road, you hear small feet behind you. It followed.

events.name: It Saw What You Did
events.intro: A Pokémon at the edge of the path has been watching for a long time. It saw how you treated others on this road. It holds something in its mouth: something you dropped.

success.text: It drops it in your hand. A Berry, a little chewed.
It nods, once, and is gone.
It considers you for a long time. Then it puts the thing at your feet and walks away, not hurried. Somewhere, the road's opinion of you shifts a little.

remembers.notice: It drops the thing and steps closer. It liked what it saw.

success.text: It looks at you for a long moment, then falls into step beside you. It joins you.

remembers.notice: In its mouth: the very Berry you gave the starving Poochyena. It was watching then too.

events.name: This Place Remembers
events.intro: A place that seems familiar. The ground, the air and the old stones seem to remember the battles fought here. Faint shapes of Pokémon battling, fading.

success.text: The shapes fight, and fade, and fight again. One of them is a {starter}. Yours watches it a long time.
You call out. One shape stops, and turns its head toward you. Then it's gone.
You walk through. The shapes part around you.

events.name: The Dragon's Question
events.intro: A shrine on a lake. An elder of the dragon clan sits on the steps. Elder Ryuen: "I'll ask three questions. There are no right answers. There are true ones. I'll know."

success.text: Ryuen: "What matters most in battle?"
Ryuen nods. The lake is very still.

events.name: The Dragon's Question
events.intro: Ryuen: "What matters most in battle?"

success.text: Ryuen: "Hm."

branches.text: Ryuen: "Yes. That is true of you."

success.text: Ryuen looks at your team for a long time. "Hm."

branches.text: Ryuen: "Yes. You have never left one of them lying at a rest."

success.text: Ryuen: "Everyone is learning. True."

events.name: The Dragon's Question
events.intro: Ryuen: "Which of your Pokémon have you used least?"

success.text: Ryuen looks at the one you chose, then at you.

events.name: The Dragon's Question
events.intro: Ryuen: "Have you ever been unkind to a Pokémon?"

success.text: Ryuen: "True."

branches.text: Ryuen says nothing for a long time. The lake says nothing either.
Ryuen says nothing for a long time. The lake says nothing either.
Ryuen says nothing for a long time. The lake says nothing either.

success.text: Ryuen: "Hm. I don't think you have."

branches.text: Ryuen: "True. Thank you for saying it."
Ryuen: "True. Thank you for saying it."
Ryuen: "True. Thank you for saying it."

success.text: Ryuen: "You do know. You were kind."

events.name: The Dragon's Question
events.intro: Ryuen stands, and looks out over the lake.

success.text: Something rises from the lake: a Dratini, already knowing a move it shouldn't. Ryuen: "It chose you. Be worth it."
A Dratini rises from the lake and swims to your feet. Ryuen: "Close enough. It thinks so, anyway."
Ryuen: "Come back when you know yourself better." The shrine stays where it is.

events.name: The Oath Stone
events.intro: An old stone with three hand-shaped hollows. Shrine keeper, Brother Osk: "Swear an oath, and the road will ask you to keep it. Keep it and you're paid."

success.text: You put your hand in the first hollow. Steel: never flee a battle. The stone is cold, and then warm.
You put your hand in the second hollow. Mercy: never knock out a wild Pokémon you could have caught or calmed. The stone is warm.
You put your hand in the third hollow. Speed: never rest at more than one rest stop in a stage. The stone hums.
Osk: "Wise, maybe." He goes back to sweeping the stone.

events.name: Reckoning: Steel
events.intro: Osk at a crossroads, waiting. Osk: "You swore Steel. Have you held to it?"

success.text: Osk: "...No." He turns away. Word of it gets around.

branches.text: Osk: "You have." He puts his hand on your lead's shoulder. It stands a little straighter, for good.

success.text: Osk: "No, you didn't. But honesty's worth something." He gives you nothing.

branches.text: Osk: "Honest. That's worth something." A smaller pay: a Hard Stone from his pocket.

events.name: Reckoning: Mercy
events.intro: A child runs up with a thank-you flower. Child: "The shrine said you kept your mercy!"

success.text: In your hand the flower wilts. The child looks at it, confused, then at you.

branches.text: The flower stays bright. The pay: your whole team is gentler with every Pokémon they meet.

success.text: Osk steps out of the crowd. Osk: "You didn't." The child's flower droops.

branches.text: Osk steps out of the crowd. Osk: "You did." The pay, and the child hugs every one of your Pokémon.

events.name: Reckoning: Speed
events.intro: Wind at a bend in the road. The oath sits lightly on your shoulder.

success.text: You run. The oath slips off somewhere along the way. Nothing comes of it.

branches.text: You run, and the wind runs with you. The pay: your lead starts every battle a step faster, for the rest of the run.

success.text: You stop. The wind goes on without you. The oath is over. No pay, no penalty.

events.name: A Friend in Need
events.intro: A young trainer trips and spills their Poké Balls. The Oracle's words come back to you. Three Balls roll toward a river.

success.text: You catch two. The third goes in the river. It floats. They find it downstream, laughing with relief.
You help them up first. The Balls are gone for a while, all three, and then found, one by one, in the reeds.

choices.label: Send a Pokémon for the river one.

success.text: Your Pokémon dives and comes up with the third Ball in its mouth. All three saved. The trainer won't stop thanking you. "If you ever need a hand in a fight..."

events.name: A Loss
events.intro: You reach into your bag. Something is gone. The Oracle's words come back to you.

success.text: A whole node of walking back. You find it, broken, in a ditch. Half its worth, in money.
You let it go. Somewhere, an old woman with closed eyes nods: "You let it go. That was the soft way."
One of your Pokémon looks very guilty. It was playing with it. It gives it back, a little chewed.

events.name: A Win That Matters
events.intro: A challenger calls you out. The Oracle's words come back to you. Challenger: "You! I've heard you can't be beaten."

success.text: This one matters. You can feel it.
Challenger: "An old woman with closed eyes." Then they send out their first.
Challenger: "Prove it."
